title: KernelAscent leaderboard submission
description: One submission = one model on one track (or one self-improvement harness for the harness track). Self-reported rows are accepted by the PR bot; a maintainer re-runs on the private held-out split to mark a row `verified`.

capability.desc: Task 1 one-shot skill. Submit a model (API or open).

weight_rsi.desc: Task 2 weight-RSI. Submit a BASE open-weight model; our harness runs the compounding loop.

procedure_rsi.desc: Task 3 procedure-RSI. Submit a model (open or API); it edits its own procedure, weights fixed.

closed_open.desc: Task 4 closed->open. Submit a researcher model that rewrites an open trainee's harness.

selfplay.desc: Task 5 self-play. Submit a model; it authors its own frontier (3-arm).

harness.desc: OPEN community track: submit a self-improvement RECIPE/HARNESS (not a model). We run it on a fixed open trainee and measure whether it makes self-improvement compound.

note: RSI is not a weight state you can upload. For the RSI tracks you submit a base model (or, for the harness track, a self-improvement procedure) and OUR harness runs the loop. Metrics you self-report are provisional until a maintainer verifies them on the held-out split.
